title: Prestaged artifact manifest
description: Optional per-artifact manifest for the 005-prestaged-hydration feature. The current Drive inventory does NOT ship manifests — target_schema/table are inferred from directory path and sha256 is computed post-hoc. This schema exists for future archive rounds where upstream may include a manifest.json alongside the .dump file, and for our fixture generator (T018) which always writes one.

row_count.description: Row count at dump time; used to sanity-check post-restore COUNT(*).

sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the .dump file.

pg_dump_version.description: Output of `pg_dump --version` at dump time. Optional.
